summary: Coconino NF tower: 1915 wooden tower, 1927 Aermotor replacement; cabin NRHP-listed 1988 and collapsed 2018; tower demolished by 2024, only rubble left.

facts.design: 48' Aermotor LX-24 steel tower with 7'x7' metal cab, replacing a 1915 wooden tower
facts.status_note: Tower demolished by 2024 with only rubble remaining (FFLOS); NHLR says removed by 2024; West Lookouts says removed 2019; cabin collapsed December 2018

access.note: The Forest had removed the lowest stair treads to deter public access (2018 federal review); no source read describes current access to the site

events.note: Wooden tower built at a reported cost of $139 (NHLR); West Lookouts gives 1914-18 and $139.63
Fire near Allen Lake found by lookout fire guard J.E. Wiley; traced to a camping party in charge of L.V. Rush, who was fined $10
48-foot steel Aermotor LX-24 tower with 7 x 7 cab replaced the earlier wood tower
Cabin for the lookout, dated 1928 by the federal review
Mr. and Mrs. Sam Saunders stationed at the lookout for the summer
Cabin entered into the National Register on January 28, 1988; the tower was found ineligible
Cabin collapsed in December 2018 after lack of maintenance
Coconino NF proposed removing the tower and cabin remains; SHPO concurred with the Forest's decision to delist the cabin from the Register in a letter dated February 20, 2019
West Lookouts says the tower was removed in 2019 (single source)
NHLR lists the tower removed by 2024; FFLOS says it was demolished by 2024, with only rubble remaining

corrections.why: The 1927 date is the steel replacement tower; the NHLR says it replaced a wooden tower built in 1915.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR and West Lookouts give 48 feet (14.6 m); the 2018 federal review gives 50 feet. The record keeps 14.6 m from the NHLR and the story reports both figures.
West Lookouts says the tower was removed in 2019; the NHLR says removed by 2024 and FFLOS says demolished by 2024. Both dates are kept as events and the story reports both.

The NHLR gives 1915 and a reported cost of $139; West Lookouts gives 1914-18 and $139.63. The story gives the 1915 date from the NHLR and the cost as a reported figure, and notes the later page's dates.

sources.title: Mormon Lake Lookout Cabin, NRHP documentation, Coconino National Forest

notes_for_editor: Tower is gone and the cabin collapsed in December 2018 (federal review). Removal date conflicts (2019 in West Lookouts, by 2024 in NHLR and FFLOS) and height conflicts (48 ft vs 50 ft) are both left visible in the story. No source read describes what remains of the cabin, or current public access, beyond FFLOS saying only rubble remains of the tower. Staffing is set to unstaffed as of 2024 by inference from the demolition; change to unknown if you prefer a sourced-only status. The NPGallery PDF is OCR text, so only clean lines were quoted. The 2021 AZ Central hike article was blocked (HTTP 403) and is not used. The West Lookouts page is a hobbyist history and its 2019 removal date is single-sourced.
